title: I'm not sure this item is for hot food
text:
I'm not sure this item is for hot food. I put hot food on this cutting board and it started to change shapes. After I took my food off of the cutting board and let it cool down, it went back to original shape. I'm wondering if this item is only for cutting cold foods.

This item also scratches very easily. Within the first use of cutting foods, I already see knife marks all over it. Is this item not for sharp knives?!?
